## Synopsis

```text
perch mail search [OPTIONS]
```

## Description

Search a mailbox with IMAP SEARCH and print metadata for matching messages. Results are newest first by default; --reverse flips the order.

Bare query words search the message text. Supported keys: from, to, cc, bcc, subject, body, text, header:Name=Value, since, before, on, sent-since, sent-before, sent-on, seen, unseen, answered, unanswered, flagged, unflagged, deleted, undeleted, draft, undraft, larger, smaller, uid, flag/keyword, and unflag/unkeyword.

Aliases: `find`.

## Notes

- The default limit is 50; --limit 0 means unlimited.
- The mailbox is examined read-only, so search does not change flags.

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--username, -u <value>` | account username (env PERCH_IMAP_USER) |
| `--password <value>` | account password (prefer PERCH_IMAP_PASSWORD or --password-file) |
| `--password-file <value>` | read the account password from a file |
| `--password-stdin` | read the account password from stdin |
| `--timeout <value>` | connection timeout (default: 30s) |
| `--config <value>` | configuration file (default: ~/.config/perch/perch.yaml) |
| `--mailbox, -m <value>` | mailbox to search (default: "INBOX") |
| `--query, -q <value>` | search expression (see the examples in --help) |
| `--uids <value>` | explicit UID set, for example 1,3:5,10:* |
| `--limit, -n <value>` | maximum results (0 means unlimited) (default: 50) |
| `--reverse` | oldest first instead of newest first |
| `--json` | write one JSON object per message |
| `--server, -s <value>` | IMAP server (imaps://host, imap://host, or host[:port]); defaults from --config |
| `--plaintext` | connect to IMAP without TLS (use only on trusted networks) |
| `--starttls` | require STARTTLS for IMAP |
| `--insecure` | skip IMAP TLS certificate verification |
| `--ca-file <value>` | PEM CA bundle used to verify the IMAP server certificate |
| `--help, -h` | show help |

## Examples

```sh
perch mail search -q 'from:alice since:2026-01-01'

perch mail search -q 'unseen larger:1M' --json

perch mail search --uids 12,14 --limit 0
```

## Environment

| Variable | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `PERCH_IMAP_USER` | default account username |
| `PERCH_IMAP_PASSWORD` | account password |
